doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21

title: Thanks and sign-off
summary: Allen thanks Jack and Jack hopes the boys keep up the good work.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, Jack, I certainly thank you for the interview, and it's been a pleasure, and I hope you go on living and enjoying life as good health as you are now.
I also pray that the boys keeps up the good work.
